rounds.text: Canarys Automations Ltd trades at an exceptionally low P/E ratio of 9.36x and a price-to-book value of 1.09x, sitting at a massive discount compared to sector benchmarks of 21.05x and 3.08x respectively [E1, E2, E6, E7]. Fundamental momentum is robust, highlighted by a 5-year compounded sales growth of 32%, a 5-year compounded profit growth of 40%, and a trailing twelve-month profit growth of 34% [E12, E15, E17]. Furthermore, a discounted cash flow model indicates an intrinsic value of Rs 70 per share against a market price of Rs 18.8, offering a 73.0% margin of safety, while a reverse DCF shows the current price absurdly prices in -0.1% earnings growth [E37, E38, E39]. The balance sheet is pristine with a debt-to-equity ratio of just 0.02x, borrowings reduced to Rs 2 Cr, and capital expenditure largely completed as evidenced by CWIP dropping to Rs 0 Cr [E30, E31, E32]. Insider confidence is evident as promoters have increased their holding to 58.16% in Mar 2026 from 56.59% in Mar 2024, all backed by an Information Technology sector tailwind score of +0.64 [E33, E65]. Conceded: [E4, E18, E26, E28, E36, E42, E56].
